name: sotto
description: A personal always-on-top AI overlay: screenshots, live transcription and chat, driven by global hotkeys.
author: Murilo Reis

scripts.dist:mac: electron-vite build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node scripts/koffi-prebuilds.mjs && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.dist:win:local: electron-vite build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && node scripts/koffi-win-prebuild.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.config.mjs -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false -c.electronFuses.enableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation=false
